BiblicalUsage: Rich is used for the man with much and for the man with more than he needs, and the Bible watches him closely. Nathan tells David of a rich man with exceeding many flocks and herds, the rich shall not give more than half a shekel for the ransom of the soul, the Preacher says curse not the rich in thy bedchamber, for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and the Servant is appointed a grave with the wicked and with the rich in His death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rich is a dangerous word in the Bible, because the rich man in Nathan's story is the thief, the rich man's half shekel buys no more than the poor man's, and the rich man's grave is where they lay the Servant. And I hold that the only safe riches are the ones God gives, because the rich who trust in riches fall, and the rich who trust in God are rich indeed.
